s_8911d.text_1: This is an Evoker Enchanting Chamber.
s_8911d.text_2: It can turn copied enchanted books into usable enchanted books.
s_8911d.text_3: Supply it with the experience needed for enchanting through an Experience Pump.
s_8911d.text_4: The higher the total enchantment level, the more experience and time it requires.
s_8911d.title: Evoker Enchanting Chamber
scene_1.text_1: This is a simple enchantment production line.
scene_1.text_3: Mark an enchanted book on the side...
scene_1.text_4: It will process the book below into an Enchanted Book (Copy).
scene_1.text_5: Whether it is working or not, the printer needs a water supply to keep the squid alive.
scene_1.title: Squid Printer
